name: lordspot-sdk
description: Server-side SDK for buying Megapot lottery tickets from Solana and claiming winnings via LordsPot.

scripts.guard:hosts: if grep -rEln 'https?://(localhost|127\.0\.0\.1|__SET_)' dist/; then echo 'BUILD REJECTED: the files above contain a localhost or placeholder API host. Fix src/config.ts before publishing.' && exit 1; else echo 'OK: no localhost or placeholder hosts in dist/'; fi
scripts.prepublishOnly: npm run test && npm run build && npm run guard:hosts
